name: MOTOR_TYPE
desc: Selected motor type. PWM must be turned off to change this.

name: MOTOR_POLE_PAIRS
desc: Pole pair count of the motor.

name: MOTOR_DIRECTION
desc: Motor direction bit. Inverts the motor direction.

name: MOTOR_PWM_FREQUENCY
desc: Set the frequency of the motor PWM.

name: COMMUTATION_MODE
desc: Selected FOC operation mode depending on feedback used for commutation.

name: OUTPUT_VOLTAGE_LIMIT
desc: PID UQ/UD output limit for circular limiter.

name: MAX_TORQUE
desc: Maximum motor torque. Note: This value can be temporarily exceeded marginally due to the operation of the current regulator.

name: MAX_FLUX
desc: Max. motor flux. Note: This value can be temporarily exceeded marginally due to the operation of the current regulator.

name: PWM_SWITCHING_SCHEME
desc: PWM switching scheme.

name: IDLE_MOTOR_PWM_BEHAVIOR
desc: Configure if the PWM should be off (high-z) or on (all motor phases same voltage) in commutation mode "System Off".

name: ADC_SHUNT_TYPE
desc: Shunt type used for ADC measurements.

name: ADC_I0_RAW
desc: Raw ADC measurement of the ADC I0 shunt.

name: ADC_I1_RAW
desc: Raw ADC measurement of the ADC I1 shunt.

name: ADC_I2_RAW
desc: Raw ADC measurement of the ADC I2 shunt.

name: ADC_I3_RAW
desc: Raw ADC measurement of the ADC I3 shunt.

name: CSA_GAIN_ADC_I0_TO_ADC_I2
desc: Current sense amplifier gain for ADC I0, I1 and I2.

name: CSA_GAIN_ADC_I3
desc: Current sense amplifier gain for ADC I3.

name: CSA_FILTER_ADC_I0_TO_ADC_I2
desc: Current sense amplifier filter for ADC I0, I1 and I2.

name: CSA_FILTER_ADC_I3
desc: Current sense amplifier filter for ADC I3.

name: CURRENT_SCALING_FACTOR
desc: Current scaling factor converting internal units to real- world units.

name: PHASE_UX1_ADC_MAPPING
desc: Mapping ADC to UX1.

name: PHASE_VX2_ADC_MAPPING
desc: Mapping ADC to VX2.

name: PHASE_WY1_ADC_MAPPING
desc: Mapping ADC to WY1.

name: PHASE_Y2_ADC_MAPPING
desc: Mapping ADC to Y2.

name: ADC_I0_SCALE
desc: Scaling applied to ADC I0.

name: ADC_I1_SCALE
desc: Scaling applied to ADC I1.

name: ADC_I2_SCALE
desc: Scaling applied to ADC I2.

name: ADC_I3_SCALE
desc: Scaling applied to ADC I3.

name: ADC_I0_INVERTED
desc: Invert the reading of ADC I0.

name: ADC_I1_INVERTED
desc: Invert the reading of ADC I1.

name: ADC_I2_INVERTED
desc: Invert the reading of ADC I2.

name: ADC_I3_INVERTED
desc: Invert the reading of ADC I3.

name: ADC_I0_OFFSET
desc: Offset applied to ADC I0 measurement.

name: ADC_I1_OFFSET
desc: Offset applied to ADC I1 measurement.

name: ADC_I2_OFFSET
desc: Offset applied to ADC I2 measurement.

name: ADC_I3_OFFSET
desc: Offset applied to ADC I3 measurement.

name: ADC_I0
desc: Scaled and offset compensated ADC I0 measurement.

name: ADC_I1
desc: Scaled and offset compensated ADC I1 measurement.

name: ADC_I2
desc: Scaled and offset compensated ADC I2 measurement.

name: ADC_I3
desc: Scaled and offset compensated ADC I3 measurement.

name: OPENLOOP_ANGLE
desc: Phi_e calculated by the ramper hardware. Used for commutation in openloop modes.

name: OPENLOOP_CURRENT
desc: Openloop current applied in openloop, current mode.

name: OPENLOOP_VOLTAGE
desc: Openloop voltage applied in openloop, voltage mode.

name: ACCELERATION_FF_GAIN
desc: Gain applied to acceleration feedforward.

name: ACCELERATION_FF_SHIFT
desc: Shift applied to acceleration feedforward.

name: RAMP_ENABLE
desc: Enable the application of acceleration and deceleration ramps.

name: DIRECT_VELOCITY_MODE
desc: Specify the control loop structure for velocity mode. Directly regulating the velocity or regulating on a constantly calculated target position.

name: RAMP_AMAX
desc: Acceleration in top part of eight-point ramp.

name: RAMP_A1
desc: First acceleration in eight-point ramp.

name: RAMP_A2
desc: Second acceleration in eight-point ramp.

name: RAMP_DMAX
desc: Deceleration in top part of eight-point ramp.

name: RAMP_D1
desc: Second deceleration in eight-point ramp.

name: RAMP_D2
desc: First deceleration in eight-point ramp.

name: RAMP_VMAX
desc: Maximum velocity of eight-point ramp.

name: RAMP_V1
desc: Velocity threshold to switch from A1/D1 to A2/D2.

name: RAMP_V2
desc: Velocity threshold to switch from A2/D2 to AMAX/DMAX.

name: RAMP_VSTART
desc: Start velocity of ramp.

name: RAMP_VSTOP
desc: Stop velocity of ramp. Needs to be greater than 0.

name: RAMP_TVMAX
desc: Minimum time at VMAX to start deceleration.

name: RAMP_TZEROWAIT
desc: Wait time at end of ramp to signal stop.

name: ACCELERATION_FEEDFORWARD_ENABLE
desc: Enable the acceleration feedforward feature.

name: VELOCITY_FEEDFORWARD_ENABLE
desc: Enable the velocity feedforward feature.

name: RAMP_VELOCITY
desc: Target velocity calculated by ramp controller.

name: RAMP_POSITION
desc: Target position calculated by ramp controller.

name: HALL_PHI_E
desc: Phi_e calculated from hall feedback.

name: HALL_SECTOR_OFFSET
desc: Hall sensor 60-degree/sector offset composed of 120 offset (order) and 180 degree offset (polarity).

name: HALL_FILTER_LENGTH
desc: Filter length of the hall sensor input signal filters.

name: HALL_POSITION_0_OFFSET
desc: Hall offset compensation for 0 degree hall position.

name: HALL_POSITION_60_OFFSET
desc: Hall offset compensation for 60 degree hall position.

name: HALL_POSITION_120_OFFSET
desc: Hall offset compensation for 120 degree hall position.

name: HALL_POSITION_180_OFFSET
desc: Hall offset compensation for 180 degree hall position.

name: HALL_POSITION_240_OFFSET
desc: Hall offset compensation for 240 degree hall position.

name: HALL_POSITION_300_OFFSET
desc: Hall offset compensation for 300 degree hall position.

name: HALL_INVERT_DIRECTION
desc: Invert the hall angle direction.

name: HALL_EXTRAPOLATION_ENABLE
desc: Enable the hall extrapolation to generate a higher resolution position signal. The extrapolation is only active at speeds higher than 60 rpm.

name: HALL_PHI_E_OFFSET
desc: Use this parameter to compensate hall sensor mounting tolerances.

name: ABN_1_PHI_E
desc: Phi_e calculated from abn feedback.

name: ABN_1_STEPS
desc: ABN 1 encoder steps per rotation (CPR).

name: ABN_1_DIRECTION
desc: ABN 1 encoder rotation direction.

name: ABN_1_INIT_METHOD
desc: Select an ABN encoder initialization method that fits best to your motor's sensors. Forces the rotor into phi_e zero using the open loop current but actively swings the rotor. Forces the rotor into phi_e 90 degree position and then into zero position using the open loop current. Turns the motor slightly in hall commutation mode until a hall signal change gives a new absolut position, which then the ABN phi_e is aligned to. Turns the motor slightly in open loop commutation mode until a N-channel is reached and gives an absolut position, which then the ABN phi_e is aligned to.

name: ABN_1_INIT_STATE
desc: Actual state of ABN encoder initialization.

name: ABN_1_INIT_DELAY
desc: When one of the "Forced phi_e" initialization methods is used, this value defines the wait time until the phi_e ABN angle is set to zero. This parameter should be set in a way, that the motor has stopped mechanical oscillations after the specified time.

name: ABN_1_INIT_VELOCITY
desc: Init velocity for ABN encoder initialization with N- channel offset.

name: ABN_1_N_CHANNEL_PHI_E_OFFSET
desc: Offset between phi_e zero and the ABN encoders index pulse position. This value is updated asynchronously on any ABN initialization other than the "Use-N channel offset" method. The value can then be used for the "Use N-channel offset" based initialization.

name: ABN_1_N_CHANNEL_INVERTED
desc: ABN 1 encoder N-channel is inverted.

name: ABN_1_N_CHANNEL_FILTERING
desc: ABN 1 encoder N-channel filtering. Useful for imprecise encoders with the index pulses lasting multiple A/B steps.

name: ABN_1_CLEAR_ON_NEXT_NULL
desc: Clear the actual position on the next ABN 1 encoder N- channel event.

name: ABN_1_VALUE
desc: Raw ABN encoder internal counter value.

name: TARGET_TORQUE
desc: Target torque value. Write to activate torque regulation.

name: ACTUAL_TORQUE
desc: Actual motor torque value.

name: TARGET_FLUX
desc: Target flux value.

name: ACTUAL_FLUX
desc: Actual motor flux value.

name: TORQUE_OFFSET
desc: Offset applied to torque value.

name: TORQUE_P
desc: P parameter for torque PI regulator. Also controls flux P parameter unless separate torque/flux loops are enabled.

name: TORQUE_I
desc: I parameter for torque PI regulator. Also controls flux I parameter unless separate torque/flux loops are enabled.

name: FLUX_P
desc: P parameter for flux PI regulator. Only available when separated torque/flux loops are enabled.

name: FLUX_I
desc: I parameter for flux PI regulator. Only available when separated torque/flux loops are enabled.

name: SEPARATE_TORQUE_FLUX_PI_PARAMTERS
desc: Enable to configure separate PI values for the torque and flux current control loops.

name: CURRENT_NORM_P
desc: P parameter normalization format for current PI regulator.

name: CURRENT_NORM_I
desc: I parameter normalization format for current PI regulator.

name: TORQUE_PI_ERROR
desc: Torque PI regulator error.

name: FLUX_PI_ERROR
desc: Flux PI regulator error.

name: TORQUE_PI_INTEGRATOR
desc: Integrated error of torque PI regulator.

name: FLUX_PI_INTEGRATOR
desc: Integrated error of flux PI regulator.

name: FLUX_OFFSET
desc: Offset applied to flux value.

name: VELOCITY_SENSOR_SELECTION
desc: Feedback source for the velocity PI regulator.

name: TARGET_VELOCITY
desc: Target velocity value. Write to activate velocity regulation.

name: ACTUAL_VELOCITY
desc: Actual velocity value.

name: VELOCITY_OFFSET
desc: Offset applied to velocity value.

name: VELOCITY_P
desc: P parameter for velocity PI regulator.

name: VELOCITY_I
desc: I parameter for velocity PI regulator.

name: VELOCITY_NORM_P
desc: P parameter normalization format for velocity PI regulator.

name: VELOCITY_NORM_I
desc: I parameter normalization format for velocity PI regulator.

name: VELOCITY_PI_INTEGRATOR
desc: Integrated error of velocity PI regulator.

name: VELOCITY_PI_ERROR
desc: Velocity PI regulator error.

name: VELOCITY_SCALING_FACTOR
desc: Scaling factor to convert internal velocity to real-world units.

name: STOP_ON_VELOCITY_DEVIATION
desc: Maximum of velocity deviation tolerated before stop event is triggered (if activated).

name: VELOCITY_LOOP_DOWNSAMPLING
desc: Downsampling factor for velocity controller.

name: VELOCITY_REACHED_THRESHOLD
desc: Deviation between target and actual velocity below which the velocity reached flag goes active and latches. If a new target velocity is set the flag is reset.

name: VELOCITY_METER_SWITCH_THRESHOLD
desc: Velocity threshold switching from period to frequency velocity meter.

name: VELOCITY_METER_SWITCH_HYSTERESIS
desc: Velocity hysteresis for switching back from frequency to period velocity meter.

name: VELOCITY_METER_MODE
desc: Currently used velocity meter mode. Measurement of velocity by time measurement between position changes. Velocity Meter running at PWM frequency. Calculates the velocity using the difference of the angle in one clock cycle. Measurement of velocity by software.

name: POSITION_SENSOR_SELECTION
desc: Feedback source for the position PI regulator.

name: TARGET_POSITION
desc: Target position value. Write to activate position regulation.

name: ACTUAL_POSITION
desc: Actual position value.

name: POSITION_SCALING_FACTOR
desc: Scaling factor to convert internal position to real-world units.

name: POSITION_P
desc: P parameter for position PI regulator.

name: POSITION_I
desc: I parameter for position PI regulator.

name: POSITION_NORM_P
desc: P parameter normalization format for position PI regulator.

name: POSITION_NORM_I
desc: I parameter normalization format for position PI regulator.

name: POSITION_PI_INTEGRATOR
desc: Integrated error of position PI regulator.

name: POSITION_PI_ERROR
desc: Error of position PI regulator.

name: STOP_ON_POSITION_DEVIATION
desc: Maximum of position deviation tolerated before stop event is triggered (if activated).

name: POSITION_LOOP_DOWNSAMPLING
desc: Downsampling factor for position controller.

name: LATCH_POSITION
desc: Position switch latched.

name: POSITION_LIMIT_LOW
desc: Position limit low.

name: POSITION_LIMIT_HIGH
desc: Position limit high.

name: POSITION_REACHED_THRESHOLD
desc: Deviation between target and actual position below which the position reached flag goes active and latches. If a new target position is set the flag is reset.

name: REFERENCE_SWITCH_ENABLE
desc: Bitwise enable for stopping when reference switch input is triggered. Bit 2: Stop on reference input home. Bit 1: Stop on reference input right. Bit 0: Stop on reference input left.

name: REFERENCE_SWITCH_POLARITY_AND_SWAP
desc: Bitwise configuration of reference switch configuration. Options to swap left and right input and invert switch polarity. Bit 3: Swap left and right switch. Bit 2: Invert polarity of home switch. Bit 1: Invert polarity of right switch. Bit 0: Invert polarity of left switch.

name: REFERENCE_SWITCH_LATCH_SETTINGS
desc: Bitwise configuration of reference switch latch configuration. Writing position to latch position parameter. Bit 3: Trigger latch on falling home signal. Bit 2: Trigger latch on rising home signal. Bit 1: Trigger latch on falling left and right signal. Bit 0: Trigger latch on rising left and right signal

name: EVENT_STOP_SETTINGS
desc: Bitwise configuration of stop configuration. Bit 2: Stop if the velocity loop deviation is larger then the parameter "Stop on velocity deviation". Bit 1: Stop if the position loop deviation is larger then the parameter "Stop on position deviation". Bit 0: If enabled the system ramps down to zero if a stop condition rises. Doing a soft and not a hard stop.

name: REFERENCE_SWITCH_SEARCH_MODE
desc: Determine the reference switch search sequence. Search for left limit switch. Search for right limit switch then search for left limit switch. Search for right limit switch then approach left limit switch from both sides. Approach left limit switch from both sides. Search for home switch in negative direction, turn around if left end switch detected. Search for home switch in positive direction, turn around if right end switch detected. Search for home switch in negative direction, ignore end switch. Search for home switch in positive direction, ignore end switch.

name: REFERENCE_SWITCH_SEARCH_SPEED
desc: Speed used for the reference switch search sequence.

name: REFERENCE_SWITCH_SPEED
desc: Lower speed used e.g. for positioning the motor at a reference switch position.

name: RIGHT_LIMIT_SWITCH_POSITION
desc: Right limit switch position.

name: HOME_SWITCH_POSITION
desc: Home switch position.

name: LAST_REFERENCE_POSITION
desc: Last reference position.

name: ABN_2_STEPS
desc: ABN 2 encoder steps per rotation (CPR).

name: ABN_2_DIRECTION
desc: ABN 2 encoder rotation direction.

name: ABN_2_GEAR_RATIO
desc: ABN 2 encoder gear ratio.

name: ABN_2_ENABLE
desc: Enable the ABN 2 encoder. Disabling resets the counted steps.

name: ABN_2_VALUE
desc: Raw ABN2 encoder internal counter value.

name: SPI_ENCODE_CS_SETTLE_DELAY_TIME
desc: Add a delay from CS going low to first SCLK edge.

name: SPI_ENCODER_CS_IDLE_DELAY_TIME
desc: Extend CS idle time between SPI message frames.

name: SPI_ENCODER_MAIN_TRANSFER_CMD_SIZE
desc: Size of the first SPI transfer frame.

name: SPI_ENCODER_SECONDARY_TRANSFER_CMD_SIZE
desc: Size of the optional secondary SPI transfer frame. If set to zero, no secondary SPI transfer.

name: SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER_DATA_3_0
desc: Used to set the transmit data and read out the received data.

name: SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER_DATA_7_4
desc: Used to set the transmit data and read out the received data.

name: SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER_DATA_11_8
desc: Used to set the transmit data and read out the received data.

name: SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER_DATA_15_12
desc: Used to set the transmit data and read out the received data.

name: SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER
desc: SPI interface setting, polarity and phase.

name: SPI_ENCODER_POSITION_COUNTER_MASK
desc: Mask to be used to collect the position counter value from the continuous received data.

name: SPI_ENCODER_POSITION_COUNTER_SHIFT
desc: Right bit shift for the position counter value before mask is applied.

name: SPI_ENCODER_POSITION_COUNTER_VALUE
desc: Actual SPI encoder position value.

name: SPI_ENCODER_COMMUTATION_ANGLE
desc: Actual absolute encoder angle value.

name: SPI_ENCODER_INITIALIZATION_METHOD
desc: Select the used absolute encoder initialization mode Forces the rotor into PHI_E zero using the open loop current but actively swings the rotor. Forces the rotor into PHI_E 90 degree position and then into zero position using the open loop current.

name: SPI_ENCODER_DIRECTION
desc: SPI encoder direction.

name: SPI_ENCODER_OFFSET
desc: This value represents the internal commutation offset. (0...max. encoder steps per rotation).

name: SPI_LUT_CORRECTION_ENABLE
desc: Enable the lookup table based encoder correction.

name: SPI_LUT_ADDRESS_SELECT
desc: Address to read or write the lookup table.

name: SPI_LUT_DATA
desc: Data to read or write to a lookup table address.

name: SPI_LUT_COMMON_SHIFT_FACTOR
desc: All LUT table entries are multiplied with 2^SHIFT_FACTOR to compensate for larger erros if needed.

name: STEP_DIR_STEP_DIVIDER_SHIFT
desc: Configure step/dir to use between 1 and 1024 microsteps per full step.

name: STEP_DIR_ENABLE
desc: Enable the Step/Dir input functionality.

name: STEP_DIR_EXTRAPOLATION_ENABLE
desc: Enable the Step/Dir extrapolation feature.

name: STEP_DIR_STEP_SIGNAL_TIMEOUT_LIMIT
desc: Step signal timeout limit.

name: STEP_DIR_MAXIMUM_EXTRAPOLATION_VELOCITY
desc: Maximum velocity up to which extrapolation is used.

name: BRAKE_CHOPPER_ENABLE
desc: Enable the brake chopper functionality.

name: BRAKE_CHOPPER_VOLTAGE_LIMIT
desc: If the brake chopper is enabled and supply voltage exceeds this value, the brake chopper output is activated.

name: BRAKE_CHOPPER_HYSTERESIS
desc: An activated brake chopper is deactivated if the actual supply voltage is lower than BRAKE_CHOPPER_VOLTAGE_LIMIT - BRAKE_CHOPPER_HYSTERESIS.

name: RELEASE_BRAKE
desc: Release the external brake by applying a PWM signal.

name: BRAKE_RELEASING_DUTY_CYCLE
desc: Set the duty cycle of the first PWM phase for releasing the brake.

name: BRAKE_HOLDING_DUTY_CYCLE
desc: Set the duty cycle of the second PWM phase to hold the brake.

name: BRAKE_RELEASING_DURATION
desc: Set the duration the brake PWM uses the first duty cycle.

name: INVERT_BRAKE_OUTPUT
desc: Invert the brake output.

name: THERMAL_WINDING_TIME_CONSTANT_1
desc: Thermal winding time constant for the used motor. Used for IIT monitoring. Setting a new value restarts the IIT monitoring.

name: IIT_LIMIT_1
desc: An actual IIT sum that exceeds this limit leads to trigger the IIT_1_EXCEEDED.

name: IIT_SUM_1
desc: Actual sum of the IIT monitor 1.

name: THERMAL_WINDING_TIME_CONSTANT_2
desc: Thermal winding time constant for the used motor. Used for IIT monitoring. Setting a new value restarts the IIT monitoring.

name: IIT_LIMIT_2
desc: An actual IIT sum that exceeds this limit leads to trigger the IIT_2_EXCEEDED.

name: IIT_SUM_2
desc: Actual sum of the IIT monitor 2.

name: RESET_IIT_SUMS
desc: Reset both IIT sums.

name: ACTUAL_TOTAL_MOTOR_CURRENT
desc: Total current through the motor windings.

name: PWM_L_OUTPUT_POLARITY
desc: PWM_L output polarity.

name: PWM_H_OUTPUT_POLARITY
desc: PWM_H output polarity.

name: BREAK_BEFORE_MAKE_TIME_LOW_UVW
desc: Break before make time for the low side gates of the UVW phases. Applied before switching from high to low.

name: BREAK_BEFORE_MAKE_TIME_HIGH_UVW
desc: Break before make time for the high side gates of the UVW phases. Applied before switching from low to high.

name: BREAK_BEFORE_MAKE_TIME_LOW_Y2
desc: Break before make time for the low side gate of the Y2 phase. Applied before switching from high to low.

name: BREAK_BEFORE_MAKE_TIME_HIGH_Y2
desc: Break before make time for the high side gate of the Y2 phase. Applied before switching from low to high.

name: USE_ADAPTIVE_DRIVE_TIME_UVW
desc: If enabled, the discharge cycle of the low- and high-side gates for the UVW phases is shortened by monitoring the gate voltages. If enabled, the value on T_DRIVE_SINK acts as an upper bound instead of a fixed time.

name: USE_ADAPTIVE_DRIVE_TIME_Y2
desc: If enabled, the discharge cycle of the low- and high-side gates for the Y2 phase is shortened by monitoring the gate voltages. If enabled, the value on T_DRIVE_SINK acts as an upper bound instead of a fixed time.

name: DRIVE_TIME_SINK_UVW
desc: Discharge time for the low and high side gates of the UVW phases. During this time, the full sink current is be applied. The applied time is defined as (1s / 120MHz) x (2 x DRIVE_TIME_SINK_UVW + 3).

name: DRIVE_TIME_SOURCE_UVW
desc: Charge time for the low and high side gates of the UVW phases. During this time, the full source current is applied. The applied time is defined as (1s / 120MHz) x (2 x DRIVE_TIME_SOURCE_UVW + 3).

name: DRIVE_TIME_SINK_Y2
desc: Discharge time for the low and high side gates of the Y2 phase. During this time, the full sink current is applied. The applied time is defined as (1s / 120MHz) x (2 x DRIVE_TIME_SINK_Y2 + 3).

name: DRIVE_TIME_SOURCE_Y2
desc: Charge time for the low and high side gates of the Y2 phase. During this time, the full source current is applied. The applied time is defined as (1s / 120MHz) x (2 x DRIVE_TIME_SOURCE_Y2 + 3).

name: UVW_SINK_CURRENT
desc: Limit the maximum sink current for the low and high side gates of the UVW phases.

name: UVW_SOURCE_CURRENT
desc: Limit the maximum source current for the low and high side gates of the UVW phases.

name: Y2_SINK_CURRENT
desc: Limit the maximum sink current for the low and high side gates of the Y2 phase.

name: Y2_SOURCE_CURRENT
desc: Limit the maximum source current for the low and high side gates of the Y2 phase.

name: BOOTSTRAP_CURRENT_LIMIT
desc: Bootstrap current limit.

name: UNDERVOLTAGE_PROTECTION_SUPPLY_LEVEL
desc: Undervoltage protection level for VS (Supply voltage). 0 disables the comparator. 1-16 are mapped to 0-15 HW values, with the comparator enabled.

name: UNDERVOLTAGE_PROTECTION_VDRV_ENABLE
desc: Enable the undervoltage protection for VDRV (Driver voltage).

name: UNDERVOLTAGE_PROTECTION_BST_UVW_ENABLE
desc: Enable the undervoltage protection on the bootstrap capacitor of the UVW phases.

name: UNDERVOLTAGE_PROTECTION_BST_Y2_ENABLE
desc: Enable the undervoltage protection on the bootstrap capacitor of the Y2 phase.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_UVW_LOW_SIDE_ENABLE
desc: Enable the overcurrent protection on the low side of the UVW phases.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_UVW_HIGH_SIDE_ENABLE
desc: Enable the overcurrent protection on the high side of the UVW phases.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_Y2_LOW_SIDE_ENABLE
desc: Enable the overcurrent protection on the low side of the Y2 phase.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_Y2_HIGH_SIDE_ENABLE
desc: Enable the overcurrent protection on the high side of the Y2 phase.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_UVW_LOW_SIDE_THRESHOLD
desc: Overcurrent protection threshold for the low side of the UVW phases (uses second list if OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_UVW_LOW_SIDE_USE_VD S=true).

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_UVW_HIGH_SIDE_THRESHOLD
desc: Overcurrent protection threshold for the high side of the UVW phases.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_Y2_LOW_SIDE_THRESHOLD
desc: Overcurrent protection threshold for the low side of the Y2 phase (uses second list if OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_Y2_LOW_SIDE_USE_VDS= true).

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_Y2_HIGH_SIDE_THRESHOLD
desc: Overcurrent protection threshold for the high side of the Y2 phase.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_UVW_LOW_SIDE_BLANKING
desc: Overcurrent protection blanking time for the low side of the UVW phases.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_UVW_HIGH_SIDE_BLANKING
desc: Overcurrent protection blanking time for the high side of the UVW phases.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_Y2_LOW_SIDE_BLANKING
desc: Overcurrent protection blanking time for the low side of the Y2 phase.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_Y2_HIGH_SIDE_BLANKING
desc: Overcurrent protection blanking time for the high side of the Y2 phase.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_UVW_LOW_SIDE_DEGLITCH
desc: Overcurrent protection deglitch time for the low side of the UVW phases.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_UVW_HIGH_SIDE_DEGLITCH
desc: Overcurrent protection deglitch time for the high side of the UVW phases.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_Y2_LOW_SIDE_DEGLITCH
desc: Overcurrent protection deglitch time for the low side of the Y2 phase.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_Y2_HIGH_SIDE_DEGLITCH
desc: Overcurrent protection deglitch time for the high side of the Y2 phase.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_UVW_LOW_SIDE_USE_VDS
desc: Use the VDS measurement for the overcurrent protection on the low side of the UVW phases.

name: OVERCURRENT_PROTECTION_Y2_LOW_SIDE_USE_VDS
desc: Use the VDS measurement for the overcurrent protection on the low side of the Y2 phase.

name: VGS_SHORT_ON_PROTECTION_UVW_LOW_SIDE_ENABLE
desc: Enable the gate-source short protection for the ON transition of the low side of the UVW phases.

name: VGS_SHORT_OFF_PROTECTION_UVW_LOW_SIDE_ENABLE
desc: Enable the gate-source short protection for the OFF transition of the low side of the UVW phases.

name: VGS_SHORT_ON_PROTECTION_UVW_HIGH_SIDE_ENABLE
desc: Enable the gate-source short protection for the ON transition of the high side of the UVW phases.

name: VGS_SHORT_OFF_PROTECTION_UVW_HIGH_SIDE_ENABLE
desc: Enable the gate-source short protection for the OFF transition of the high side of the UVW phases.

name: VGS_SHORT_ON_PROTECTION_Y2_LOW_SIDE_ENABLE
desc: Enable the gate-source short protection for the ON transition of the low side of the Y2 phase.

name: VGS_SHORT_OFF_PROTECTION_Y2_LOW_SIDE_ENABLE
desc: Enable the gate-source short protection for the OFF transition of the low side of the Y2 phase.

name: VGS_SHORT_ON_PROTECTION_Y2_HIGH_SIDE_ENABLE
desc: Enable the gate-source short protection for the ON transition of the high side of the Y2 phase.

name: VGS_SHORT_OFF_PROTECTION_Y2_HIGH_SIDE_ENABLE

name: GDRV_RETRY_BEHAVIOUR
desc: This value defines the state the system goes to after a fault condition on a motor phase occurs. The system switches off and discharges the gates. The motor can spin freely. The system switches off and, if possible and depending on fault, enables the LS or HS gates, braking the motor electrically.

name: DRIVE_FAULT_BEHAVIOUR
desc: This value defines the state the system goes to after a fault condition on a motor phase occurs and all retries failed. The system switches off and discharges the LS and HS gates, letting the motor spin freely. The system switches off and, if possible and depending on fault, enables the LS or HS gates, braking the motor electrically. The system switches off, discharges the LS and HS gates, and, if correctly configured, engages the mechanical brake. The system switches off, if possible and depending on fault, enables the LS or HS gates, and, if correctly configured, engages the mechanical brake.

name: FAULT_HANDLER_NUMBER_OF_RETRIES
desc: Maximum number of retries that are performed for every fault that is detected.
